_comment: Pattern descriptor for an ASP.NET WebForms login gated by Cloudflare Turnstile. Copy this file per portal and only change the values.
notes: The User ID field fires an onchange __doPostBack that reloads the page and renames the password and submit inputs. Never type into it with keyboard emulation between minting the token and submitting.
The submit input has a randomised name. ASP.NET only treats the request as a click when that name is present in the body, so form.submit() without it silently re-renders the login page.
